name: write_file
description: Create or overwrite a file with the given content. Creates parent directories if needed. Pass 'mode' to set the file's permission bits (e.g. "755" for an executable script).

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the file.

content.description: The full content to write to the file.

mode.description: Optional octal permission bits as 3-4 digits, e.g. "755" to make the file executable or "600" to restrict it. Anything else is rejected without writing. Default: an existing file keeps its current mode, a new file gets the process umask (typically 644, i.e. not executable).
